Flax crackers:

1 cup of milled/ground flax 1/2 cup of water 1/4 tsp salt Any other flavourings (parmesan, herbs, spices etc.)

Mix together in a bowl, spread thinly on a baking sheet. Pre-score into squares (I normally get 16-20 depending on how thinly the mixture is spread) and bake for 20-30 mins. Snap apart when they are crisp.

I use these to spread with peanut butter, guacamole, cream cheese, butter, pate. I also layer up with cheese and tomato slices. Basically anything you would use a cracker or oatcake for.
